prompt: What is the DORA Register of Information and where does the annual cycle stand?
assertions: Defines it: Art. 28(3) register of all contractual arrangements on ICT third-party services, at entity/sub-consolidated/consolidated level, in the ESA-prescribed template
States the cycle: annual regulator collection — the 2026 round used reference date December 31, 2025 with NCA submission windows in Q1 2026 (most deadlines around March 31, the NCA-to-ESA backstop)
Notes its function: feeds CTPP criticality designation and oversight
Advises continuous maintenance (updates on new/changed/terminated arrangements) rather than year-end scrambles
Connects to related duties: pre-contract due diligence, Art. 30 contract provisions, and exit strategies for critical/important functions
